name: find_definition
description: Where the symbol on a line of a file is defined, by a language server (Rust, TypeScript and JavaScript, Python, Go): at most 20 locations, each as `path:line:col: the source line`. Give the `line` (from 1) and the `symbol` on it, and `occurrence` when it is there more than once; if the symbol is not on that line the answer shows the line. A first call on a project starts the server and may wait for it to index (`wait` seconds, 1 to 120, default 30); where there is no server the answer says so. Nothing is changed. Example: {"path":"src/main.rs","line":12,"symbol":"parse_config"}

path.description: The file, relative to the worktree root

symbol.description: The text on that line the position is at (a name)

occurrence.description: Which one when the symbol is on the line more than once, from 1 (default 1)

repo.description: The slot the file is in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a server that is still indexing, 1 to 120 (default 30)
